page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.8xlarge is a high clock speed virtual server configured with 32 dedicated vCPUs derived from 16 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor running at 3.3 GHz. Built upon an x86_64 architecture and managed via KVM, the instance provides 256 GB of system RAM, yielding a high 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio. The underlying CPU supports hardware acceleration technologies including AVX-512 with VNNI and bfloat16, alongside AES encryption instructions.

The instance does not include bundled local disk storage, relying entirely on network-attached block storage for persistent data. Network throughput is provisioned with a 10 Gbps baseline bandwidth. In terms of hardware resource allocation, each physical core provides two hyperthreads and 8.0 GB of memory per core, offering dense memory capacity tailored for memory-bound computational tasks.

Benchmark results place the instance in the middle tier for stress-ng compute workloads, recording 1,571.09 in single-core and 33,012.14 in multi-core metrics. Memory performance demonstrates top-quartile performance for large-block writes at 93.48 GB/sec, alongside an uncached read bandwidth of 165.51 GB/sec. Data compression tests yield 26.77 GB/sec on single-threaded gzip and 125.32 GB/sec on multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, positioning the instance effectively for in-memory databases, caching layers, and high-memory analytics processing.
